reviews.title: Absolutely Gorgeous Case and absolutely huge : )
reviews.comment: Update:  10-2-25  This is still the best case I have ever built in.  Still going strong after almost 2 years and I still would pick this case over any other I have seen since.  I have done some more fishy upgrades to make it my own : ) Update: 11-26-23 My build is complete, I figured that if my case looks like a fish tank, why not add some fish : ) This is simply the best case I have ever had, and will be my show case for some time.  I'm so glad that Lian Li did not tint the glass on this case.  Being that the glass is clear, lets the lights colors glow off the glass giving it even more class.  If your even thinking of building in this case "and you have the desk space" then don't even hesitate.  It is fully worth the money. This was such a "huge" upgrade to my Corsair 680X.  In fact, it made that case look kinda small in comparison.  I have built my own custom desk and it's sole design is to show off my build.  But the Corsair simply did not have the space to show anything.  It was a fairly large case but was very small in the actual build area.  The Lian Li O11 Dynamic EVO XL is simply in a league of it's own.  It was a dream to build in and met all the requirements that I needed to replicate my old build, but in something that would actually show it off (compare to my old build pic).  There was plenty of room for wire management and even gave me space for my hard drive switch.  The build quality is top notch.  If I had any complaint at all, it would be that the blanks that they use in the card slots do not stay tight when other cards are in the same locking tab.  The blanks are thinner, and feel cheap compared to other brands I have built in, and thus require some sticky tape to keep them from vibrating around.  It's a small gripe, but if you have a sub woofer close to your tower, they will vibrate and make noise, and since they are specifically designed for this case, you can't use other blanks to replace them. All in all, this will be the last case I build in for some time.  It is my third, and every time I built in one of the older cases, it just didn't feel right.  This case is a work of art and will fill the bill for some time. Oh, one other small incidental issue is that due to the design of where the ssd's mount and how they mount, you cannot use a 90 degree sata on your hard drive.  The ssd's mount the wrong direction and you cannot hook the sata cable up to them.  I ended up just double sticking my drive backwards to the same area since it's the only black sata cable I had.  Not a huge issue, just something to note.
reviews.author: Handy

reviews.title: The XL is HUGE and amazing, front ports are USB 3.0/3.1
reviews.comment: I lost count of how many times I smiled when realizing all the cool things this case could do like hinged panels and so on. It was a breeze to remove the motherboard panel to get everything installed, and the wiring setups are really great. I bought the XL and it's HUUUGE. The size will be great for airflow and I bought this case specifically because it can be "reversed" (flipped so the PC can be on the left of your monitor and you still get to see everything), though the instructions for disassembling the case could be slightly better. I snapped a few plastic guides off of two panels because the instruction's images made it look like "lift" when you needed to slide a panel slightly and THEN lift. When reversing the case, the instructions for removing the bottom say, "make sure you remove the IO block" (with the USB plugs) without telling you how ... those instructions were on the next page. Also, the USB on the front panel is USB 3.1 for the USB-C port, and USB 3.0 for the USB-A ports; I wish the product page would have been more clear about that. Also, the USB-A ports are not colored blue. Overall, great case, I'm very happy with my purchase. Packaging was great, arrived completely intact, but the XL case is VERY large... maybe too large for what I'm going to need, but it'll sure look great on my desk. :)
reviews.author: Ian Douglas

reviews.title: Evo XL classic
reviews.comment: There's a reason this case has won so many awards back in it's prime. It's a great case with a ton of options. Love it! Will do several builds in this case before I ever consider switching it. It may be overkill if you don't watercool but for watercooling, it's one of the best cases out there. Absolutely gorgeous and spacious.
reviews.author: Seltic

reviews.title: Nice case🔥
reviews.comment: Amazing case, it can fit 2 AIO’s, airflow is amazing. It’s fully aluminum besides the glass, and it’s stylish. I’ve got a 9950x3d and a 5090 LC
reviews.author: Wesley Pavnick

reviews.title: See it all
reviews.comment: The Lian Li case was perfect for my new build. The X870e motherboard and 5090 would need a big case. This case still has room to spare with those parts in it. Building in the case was pretty easy and straightforward. The front pillar being removable to give an appearance of wrap-around glass really pulls it together. Still plenty of room for fans and cooling; in this case, 10 total fans were installed. I have a 360 AIO on the top, and with the option to change where the MB is located, it made fitting everything very easy. My recommendation to build in this case would be to make sure you have enough room to show it off.
reviews.author: Ryan
